clipchat.widget.title: ClipChat
clipchat.state.disabled_by_os: Windows clipboard history is off. Turn it on in Windows Settings, under System > Clipboard.
clipchat.state.access_denied: Windows would not hand over the history. This usually means the game window is not focused.
clipchat.state.error: Could not read the Windows clipboard history.
clipchat.error.entry_missing: That entry is no longer in the history
clipchat.error.pin_limit_reached: The pin limit has been reached
clipchat.error.windows_action_failed: Windows refused that change to its clipboard history
clipchat.config.title: ClipChat Settings
clipchat.config.theme.tooltip: Colours used by the clipboard panel. Any colour you set yourself overrides the theme.
clipchat.config.visible.tooltip: Show the clipboard panel in the chat screen. Turning this off hides it completely; you can still reach these settings with /clipchat or the ClipChat keybind.
clipchat.config.windows.tooltip: Off by default. When on, the panel gains a Windows tab that reads your Windows clipboard history live. ClipChat never writes anything from that tab to disk.
clipchat.config.capture.tooltip: Off by default. When on, text you copy in Minecraft is saved to a file on this computer and is still there after you close the game. Turn it off to keep the panel empty between sessions.
clipchat.config.max_unpinned.tooltip: How many unpinned entries to keep. The oldest is dropped once the list is full. Between 1 and 1000.
clipchat.config.max_pinned.tooltip: How many entries can be pinned at once. Pinned entries are never dropped automatically. Between 1 and 500.
clipchat.config.max_length.tooltip: Longer text is shortened to this many characters before it is stored. Between 16 and 65536.
